markdown: **Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You polish and sharpen the axe, after which its scent grows even more powerful and the axe's blade transforms into your choice of standard-grade [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2915) or standard-grade [mithral](/Equipment.aspx?ID=275) for 1 hour; then after this duration, the woodcutter's axe reverts to cold iron.
